script.source:
//@version=5
indicator("uct-rma-wma-parity-v1", overlay=false)
rma14 = ta.rma(close, 14)
wma20 = ta.wma(close, 20)
plot(rma14, title="rma14")
plot(wma20, title="wma20")

provenance.note: Captured via CSV export (Table view -> Download data) of a real SPY Daily chart with a live ta.rma(close,14)/ta.wma(close,20) indicator added, full double-precision floats. 2,031 real trading-day bars (2018-08-07..2026-09-04). rma is Wilder's smoothing (alpha=1/n), sharing UCT's own _smooth_col primitive with ema (alpha=2/(n+1)) -- SMA-of-first-window seeded, matching Pine's own documented ta.rma convention. Expected, and confirmed, to show the SAME capture-window cold-start seed-convergence lag already documented for rsi/atr/ema -- see _vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note for the measured boundary. RMA underlies rsi/atr/adx-family directly, so this is the first STANDALONE real-vendor confirmation of the shared primitive those three functions are built on, not merely an inference from their own composite results.

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: 150 is NOT the semantic period-warmup (that is 13 bars -- the first index at which rma(close,14) is computable at all). It is a conservative round number past the empirically observed convergence point (last disagreeing index measured at 130 of 2031) for the SAME general capture-window cold-start effect already documented for rsi/atr/ema (divergences.json::recursive-smoother-cold-start-in-a-finite-capture). RMA converges FASTER than the RSI/ATR composites built on it (130 vs ~169-172) -- expected, since RSI/ATR compound TWO independent RMA seed errors (avg-gain and avg-loss, or TR through the additional bar-0 question) while a standalone rma(close,14) carries only its own single seed error. Bars 150+ (1,881 of 2,031) never disagree again.
